name: Personalised laser-engraved wooden pen stand with mobile stand and visiting-card holder (custom name)
supplier_cost_note: Inoim wooden pen stand with mobile & card holder, custom engraving/print, Rs 140/piece excl. GST (IndiaMART listing 26389718897, search snippet seen 2026-11-16). Same Inoim brand from Diamond Art Creation, Surat (Gujarat): Rs 130/piece, MOQ 10 (seen 2026-11-16). Single-piece personalised drop-ship and per-piece engraving charge NOT confirmed. Higher alternatives: Chennai wooden mobile stand Rs 200; Surat customised black pen stand with clock Rs 350 (seen 2026-11-16). Rs 140 is 25.5% of Rs 549.
retail_observed: Amazon.in search snippets seen 2026-11-16: SHIVOM CRAFTS personalised wooden pen stand with name, visiting-card holder and mobile stand Rs 549 (same spec); STAR GIFTING wooden pen, card holder & mobile stand with watch and metal pen, name engraved Rs 599; SAVRI organiser with clock, pen, mobile and card holder Rs 799. Cheaper competition: Deskart name-engraved pen stand with mobile holder Rs 265; EpicLane with clock Rs 319; Deskart organiser with clock Rs 379.

demand_signals.source: Amazon.in search: personalized pen stand / customized pen stand with name
demand_signals.summary: Many sellers list personalised wooden pen stands (Deskart, EpicLane, SHIVOM CRAFTS, STAR GIFTING, SAVRI, CrownLit), positioned as gifts for doctors, CAs, advocates and corporate clients. Shows an established gift category; no sales-volume or trend data found.

risks: Price competition: same-type engraved stands sell at Rs 265-379 on Amazon.in, so Rs 549 depends on better finish, gift box and photos
Supplier is out of Odisha (Gujarat, inferred from the Surat seller of the Inoim brand), so website-only; supplier location for the Rs 140 listing not confirmed
Rs 140 listing is aimed at corporate bulk orders; single-piece personalised drop-ship, engraving charge and lead time need a written quote
Custom orders: spelling errors are seller cost; need a proof-approval step; personalised items should be non-returnable except damage or seller error
Thin MDF/wood slots can crack in transit; packaging must protect it
GST rate (HSN 4421) to be confirmed by CA; 18% used as a conservative figure
